description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hinnarandeniya, Udapalatha D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320161
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land (Parcel No. 13 and 52) with detailed land particulars including owner names, extent, location details, and title classifications. The content focuses entirely on land ownership and property registration, falling squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title settlements.
